meta.description: From M-Pesa to AI Infrastructure. Why Kenya's Silicon Savannah is the ideal launchpad for Africa's compute future.

hero.headline: Kenya: The Silicon Savannah Enters the AI Age
hero.subheadline: Kenya has a history of disrupting global industries. Now, with 1MW of AI compute, we are setting the stage for the next digital leap.

sections.title: Beyond Mobile Payments: Building the Hard Assets
sections.body: Kenya has long been a global case study for digital transformation, famously leapfrogging the West in mobile payments with M-Pesa. However, the next stage of growth requires more than just clever software; it requires 'Hard Tech' infrastructure. The Kenya AI Compute project marks a significant shift in the regional ecosystem—moving from being a consumer of global compute to being a producer. Nairobi is currently home to the highest concentration of tech talent in East Africa, with thousands of developers entering the AI and Data Science space every year. By providing this talent with local, affordable, and high-performance infrastructure, we are removing the last barrier to a true African AI boom. Our project is the foundational layer that will allow local startups to train their own LLMs for African languages and build computer vision systems for local agriculture and urban planning. sections.title: The Silicon Savannah Advantage
items: Proven Talent: Over 60,000 professional developers in the Nairobi metro area alone.
Connectivity: Africa’s most stable submarine cable landing points in Mombasa.
Pro-Tech Policy: Government-led 'Digital Masterplan' supporting high-tech FDI.
Economic Stability: A diversified economy with a strong English-speaking business culture.
Strategic Gate: The gateway to the 400M+ people in the East African Community.
